question: The simple interest on a principal amount (in ₹) is ₹888 for a period of 8 years at the rate of 2% per annum. The principal amount (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total simple interest percentage = Rate × Time

Total interest % = 2% × 8 = 16%

According to the given data, 16% of Principal = ₹888

⇒ 1% of Principal = 888 ÷ 16 = ₹55.5

⇒ 100% of Principal (Total Principal) = 55.5 × 100 = ₹5550

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹888

Time (T) = 8 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 2% per annum

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
 Principal (P)
 100%

 Total Interest = 16% of P = ₹888

**Calculations:**

⇒ 888 = (P × 2 × 8) ÷ 100

⇒ 888 = (P × 16) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (888 × 100) ÷ 16

⇒ P = 55.5 × 100

⇒ P = 5550

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Constant Rate

In simple interest, the interest is calculated only on the initial principal. The interest amount remains constant for every year if the rate and principal are unchanged.

Effective Interest Rate

The total accumulated interest over a period can be quickly calculated by multiplying the rate per annum with the number of years: Effective Rate = R × T %.

Amount Formula

The total amount at the end of the period is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + (R × T) ÷ 100).
